newsitem.title: UK: RTZ up on copper price, mining stocks rise.
newsitem.headline: RTZ up on copper price, mining stocks rise.

text.p: Shares in UK metals and mining group RTZ Plc gained over three percent on Friday, helped by firm copper prices, gains in Australian mining stocks and what dealers called a short-squeeze in the stock.
RTZ shares touched an intraday high of 981p but slipped to trade at 973-1/2p by 1258 GMT, up 26p on the day. The overall market was up half a percent at the time.
"There's nothing too dramatic in the market but the copper price and Australian mining stocks are looking good. There are a few shorts around too," one marketmaker said.
